mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_ID, U.LOGIN_ID, U.PASSWORD_HASH, U.EMPLOYEE_NO, U.USER_NAME, U.PHONE_NUMBER, U.EMAIL, U.DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_NAME, U.POSITION_ID, P.POSITION_NAME, U.ENABLED FROM USERS U JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_ID = U.POSITION_ID WHERE U.LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}

SELECT U.USER_ID, U.LOGIN_ID, U.EMPLOYEE_NO, U.USER_NAME, U.PHONE_NUMBER, U.EMAIL, U.DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_NAME, U.POSITION_ID, P.POSITION_NAME, U.ENABLED FROM USERS U JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_ID = U.POSITION_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT R.ROLE_CODE FROM USER_ROLE UR JOIN ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY R.ROLE_CODE
SELECT DEPT_ID AS "id", DEPT_NAME AS "name" FROM DEPARTMENT ORDER BY DEPT_NAME
SELECT POSITION_ID AS "id", POSITION_NAME AS "name" FROM POSITION ORDER BY POSITION_LEVEL, POSITION_ID

SELECT U.USER_ID, U.LOGIN_ID, U.USER_NAME, D.DEPT_NAME, P.POSITION_NAME, NVL( LISTAGG(R.ROLE_CODE, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY R.ROLE_CODE), '일반 사용자' ) AS ROLE_NAMES, U.ENABLED FROM USERS U JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_ID = U.POSITION_ID LEFT JOIN USER_ROLE UR ON UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID GROUP BY U.USER_ID, U.LOGIN_ID, U.USER_NAME, D.DEPT_NAME, P.POSITION_NAME, U.ENABLED ORDER BY U.USER_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS U JOIN USER_ROLE UR ON UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID JOIN ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE U.LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND U.ENABLED = 'Y' AND R.ROLE_CODE = 'SYSTEM_ADMIN'

SELECT ROLE_ID FROM ROLE WHERE ROLE_CODE IN
#{roleCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS ( USER_ID, DEPT_ID, POSITION_ID, LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD_HASH, USER_NAME, ENABLED, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{positionId}, #{loginId}, #{passwordHash}, #{userName}, 'Y', SYSTIMESTAMP )
